full_judgment: 2. The facts, in brief, are that the predecessor-in-interest of the respondents filed Other Suit No.11 of 1992 in the Court of the learned Assistant Judge, Dhamoirhat Upazilla, Naogaon for declaration that an order dated 26.09.1990 in Miscellaneous Case No. 268(13)/89 of the Additional Deputy Commissioner (Rev.), Naogaon (defendant No.2) is illegal, void and not binding upon the plaintiff and that the kubuliyat dated 18.11.1990 executed by the defendant No.2 in favour of the defendant No.1 is collusive and not binding upon the plaintiff in respect of .06 acre of land in Plot No.1 under Khatian No.1 of Mouza Mukundapar, P.S. Dhamoirhat, District- Naogaon.
